name: ci-panel
title: CiPanel
description: "Run it from CI" panel: a title (with an optional pill), a hint, a Copy button, the command and a footnote, shown by a toggle button. Used on TestRun and AgentTestRun.

a11y.pattern: A <section> region named by its title, disclosed by a native <button aria-expanded aria-controls>
keyboard: On the toggle: shows or hides the panel
Reaches the Copy button inside the panel
aria: The toggle carries aria-expanded and aria-controls; its expanded look (action border on selected) is not the only cue
Copy announces "Copied" in a polite live region (copy-button)
The command wraps (pre-wrap), so the panel never scrolls sideways
a11y.notes: Muted hint and footnote keep 4.5:1 on the surface fill. Put the toggle class on the Button: class="ci-panel-toggle".
